<!--
Title: a conventional commit in plain language that says what changes for the person using laddu,
such as "fix(api): Stop no longer stops other people's answers in a shared thread".
One problem per PR. Start the body with "Fixes #N" or "Part of #N".
-->

Fixes #

## Problem

<!-- The problem in a sentence or two: what happens, what should happen, and how to reproduce it
(steps, environment, logs) where relevant. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it, in plain words. A short bullet per part when it spans several areas, each
with a bold lead word. Say what deliberately stays the same, and any trade-off. -->

## Scope

<!-- The issue or request this answers, and why everything in the diff belongs to that one problem.
Name related issues it does not cover. -->

## Verification

<!-- The focused tests or manual checks you ran and what you observed, for the changed behavior.
Say whether a new test fails without the fix. End with "Not checked:" and anything you couldn't
check. "Tests pass" alone is not enough. Slack-visible changes need before/after screenshots
uploaded to GitHub, and a short recording when timing or interaction matters. -->

<!-- If an agent did the work, end with the model and harness, e.g.
"Written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code, running inside T3 Code." -->
